comparison.objective: Clip a pulse oximeter onto an index finger without moving the hand; the candidate configures a gripper opening stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Spring-clip squeeze-slide-release with hand stabilization versus coaxial adjustment and locknut counterholding.
comparison.success_condition: Oximeter is seated, correctly oriented, released, and the hand remains near its mark; candidate requires locked angle retention through cycles.
comparison.reason: Spring-clip placement on a supported finger is a different physical ability from torque-coupled mechanical calibration.
